Q: Determine windows system wide font A:

GetSysColor(COLOR_MENUTEXT) gives you the menu font colour.

SystemParametersInfo Will allow you to recover some font information, likewise GetStockObject for drawing on the device context.

But the system font is (probably) either Tahoma (on XP/W2K) or MS Sans Serif depending on how you set up your Dialog.

See https://devblogs.microsoft.com/oldnewthing/20050204-00/?p=36523 for more.

Q: cast/convert join type data in codeigniter A:

For fully control of quoting, disable automated quoting and use escape_identifiers() as desired.

$this->db->join(
    't_mtr_activity_employee',
    vsprintf(
        '%s = CAST(%s)',
        ['t_trx_activity.nik', 't_mtr_employee.nik']
    ),
    'inner',
    false
);

See a similar implementation:

  • CodeIgniter SELECT query with JOIN conditions using FIND_IN_SET() is not returning the expected results

Because your JOIN doesn't need identifier quotes to render a valid query, you could simply use the following.

$this->db->join(
    't_mtr_activity_employee',
    't_trx_activity.nik = CAST(t_mtr_employee.nik)',
    'inner',
    false
);
